  aluminum used to produce beverage cans, bottles and cups in the regions where we operate (2030).

Meet AeroFlexx

## Think outside the bottle.

We took the positive attributes of rigid and flexible packaging and eliminated the negatives to
create an entirely new form of liquid packaging. AeroFlexx is an all-in-one packaging solution that
can simplify your brand’s supply chain, can be curbside recyclable where all plastic bottles are
accepted, and deliver an enhanced dispensing experience. 

Our Packaging Technology

At AeroFlexx, we've discovered a better way of packaging, shipping, and dispensing liquids. Built
with both brands and consumers in mind, our **innovative liquid packaging solution** is
revolutionizing the industry as we know it.

Manufacturing

## Durable packaging that's built to last.

Manufacture liquid packaging the right way with 50-70 percent less plastic. Traditional packaging
manufacturing relies on the use of molds, which are costly to maintain and expensive to change. Our
cutting-edge technology is **mold-free and tamper-proof** off the line, creating a smoother
manufacturing process and improving the bottom line.

[ Our Machines ][55]
[Two Aeroflexx Paks on counter top]
Branding

## Custom designs that stand out on shelves.

At AeroFlexx, our innovation transforms your packaging process from start to finish. We're giving
more power back to brands with 360-degree artwork so you can showcase your brand's unique style and
attract the attention of new consumers.

[ Our Branding Process ][56]
[Person holding an AeroFlexx Pak]
Shipping

## Faster shipping with fewer headaches.

We make shipping straightforward and hassle-free. Traditional bottles break or spill during
shipping. With AeroFlexx Paks, you and your customers get peace of mind with **mess-free shipping
**every time. Plus, our packs are Amazon ISTA 6 approved for SIOC and over boxing, so they ship
easily in an envelope and eliminate excessive packaging requirements.

[ Our Production Process ][57]
[Woman bathing a baby with an AeroFlexx Pak of baby soap]
Total Value

## Lasting results at a lower total cost.

Not only does our process get products to consumers faster but also at a lower total cost for
brands. Thanks to **streamlined manufacturing** and **sustainable shipping methods**, you can
deliver more inventory to more consumers at a fraction of the cost.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

# ALPLA is a world leader in the development and production of innovative plastic packaging
# solutions.

We produce innovative packaging systems, bottles, caps and injection-moulded parts for a wide range
of industries since 1955. Our long history as a family-run business, our cutting-edge technologies
and the knowledge and dedication of our employees set us and our products apart. Our business
activities are founded on sustainability and the climate-friendly use of resources. With our more
than 30 years of experience in recycling and our own recycling plants, we play our part in ensuring
that plastics remain in the materials cycle.

## Your Trusted Packaging Partner

Aman Print & Pack LLP is a printing and packaging box manufacturer in Mumbai. We manufacture PP
cartons and PET, Blister and Flexible packaging solutions for several industries such as FMCG,
Pharmaceutical, Cosmetics, Home Textiles, Giftware, Lingerie/Hosiery, Stationery, Home Furnishings,
Advertising, POS Display and more.
Manufactured in Mumbai, we distribute our packaging solutions all over India and other countries
after adding expert finishing touches and conducting strict quality control. Here, every packaging
is created not just to contain the product but also to have its own uniqueness.

### [关于我们][70]

亚太森博是世界领先的浆纸生产商，在中国山东和广东都有投资，主要产品有高档化学木浆、溶解浆、高档液体包
装纸板、食品卡、烟卡、社会卡、文化用纸（含办公复印纸），产品远销世界各地。

亚太森博奉行可持续发展的理念，致力于成为规模最大、管理最佳、以可持续的资源开发为基础的集团之一，保护
环境，为客户创造价值，实现利民、利国、利业。

目前，亚太森博在中国投入运营的项目主要有：
亚太森博（山东）浆纸有限公司
亚太森博（广东）纸业有限公司
亚太森博（江苏）浆纸有限公司

### [关于我们][70]

亚太森博奉行可持续发展的理念，致力于成为规模最大、管理最佳、以可持续的资源开发为基础的集团之一，保护
环境，为客户创造价值，实现利民、利国、利业。

# We rethink packaging every day.

We are Constantia Flexibles, a global leader in consumer and pharmaceutical flexible packaging.

[Find out more][30]

## Pharma Business

Together with our partners, we protect health and ensure the safety of patients and their loved
ones.

[About Pharma][31]

## Consumer Business

We aim to provide people with the highest benefit daily at the lowest impact on the environment.

[About Consumer][32]

## People Passion Packaging

Based on the guiding principle of People Passion Packaging, we globally manufacture tailor-made
flexible packaging solutions.

## We Design for Recycling

With more than 110 years of experience in flexible packaging, we know that high‑quality and visually
appealing packaging is only part of the story. Today, packaging also needs to work within modern
recycling systems and meet evolving customer expectations.


That’s why we apply Design for Recycling principles across our development processes. Our
**Ecolutions portfolio** includes flexible packaging solutions engineered to support established
recycling streams wherever possible. These products are designed to perform strongly, protect goods,
and be handled more efficiently at end‑of‑life within available infrastructure.
 

By continuously improving material choices, design features, and production technologies, we help
customers move toward packaging that aligns with the requirements of tomorrow’s markets.

## Leading Flexible Packaging Manufacturer

At Colorful Packaging Limited, we specialize in delivering customer-focused flexible packaging
solutions that combine quality, innovation, and sustainability. As a trusted manufacturer, we offer
a comprehensive range of products including stand-up pouches, flat bottom bags, three-side seal
bags, back-sealing & gusset bags, spout pouches, coffee bags, eco-friendly and recyclable bags,
holographic foil bags, kraft paper bags, and roll stock films. Each solution is designed to protect
product freshness, enhance shelf appeal, and strengthen brand identity. With our advanced printing
technology, reliable supply chain, and strong customization capabilities, we proudly serve the food,
beverage, pet food, personal care, and household industries worldwide.

## Read Our Product Specifications

Your product deserves better packaging than a flimsy one. Every dented corner and crumpled lid of
the packaging quietly destroys customer trust in your brand. In such a case, the use of **custom
rigid packaging **is not a luxury. It is a necessity to amplify your brand identity.

At Custom Rigid Packaging, we manufacture set-up boxes that protect the product and create a
memorable unboxing experience. From 800gsm jewelry boxes to 2000gsm electronics packaging, every box
ships with your exact dimensions and exact colors.

## **What Are Custom Rigid Boxes? **

The brand invests thousands in their products with perfection. Their branding is in shape, and their
product is of high quality. But the moment customers receive a flimsy packaging with dents, they get
a negative impression of your brand. All the high-end brands use **custom rigid packaging boxes
**based on a fundamental trust, which is that the packaging is a part of the product. These boxes
are manufactured with premium-quality greyboard or chipboard cores that are wrapped in art or
textured paper. A rigid packaging does not collapse or bend.

Compared to standard folding cartons, rigid setup boxes are 4× thicker. These boxes are manufactured
to survive freight handling and retail shelving. Due to the premium nature, **custom rigid packaging
solutions **are the most preferred ones by the following brand:
* Luxury retail
* Boutique fashion
* Fine jewelry
* Luxury watches
* Premium cosmetics and skincare
* Consumer electronics and tech accessories
* Corporate gifts
* Subscription boxes
* Chocolates and artisan food gifts

### **Outer Wrapping Papers**

For **custom rigid boxes designs**, outer wrapping papers are required that can create a catchy
appearance. The core material cannot be printed due to high porosity. That is why external wraps are
applied, which can be from the following:
* **Art paper:** This paper has a GSM range of 128 to 157. Art paper is used for crisp prints and is
  ideal for CMYK artwork with photographic images.
* **Kraft paper: **It gives an organic and tactile look to the boxes. Artisan brand perfect kraft
  paper.
* **Speciality metallic paper**: Some brands prefer paper material that gives mirror-like shoes and
  is used

## Read Our Product Specifications

Your product deserves better packaging than a flimsy one. Every dented corner and crumpled lid of
the packaging quietly destroys customer trust in your brand. In such a case, the use of **custom
rigid packaging **is not a luxury. It is a necessity to amplify your brand identity.

At Custom Rigid Packaging, we manufacture set-up boxes that protect the product and create a
memorable unboxing experience. From 800gsm jewelry boxes to 2000gsm electronics packaging, every box
ships with your exact dimensions and exact colors.

## **What Are Custom Rigid Boxes? **

The brand invests thousands in their products with perfection. Their branding is in shape, and their
product is of high quality. But the moment customers receive a flimsy packaging with dents, they get
a negative impression of your brand. All the high-end brands use **custom rigid packaging boxes
**based on a fundamental trust, which is that the packaging is a part of the product. These boxes
are manufactured with premium-quality greyboard or chipboard cores that are wrapped in art or
textured paper. A rigid packaging does not collapse or bend.

Compared to standard folding cartons, rigid setup boxes are 4× thicker. These boxes are manufactured
to survive freight handling and retail shelving. Due to the premium nature, **custom rigid packaging
solutions **are the most preferred ones by the following brand:
* Luxury retail
* Boutique fashion
* Fine jewelry
* Luxury watches
* Premium cosmetics and skincare
* Consumer electronics and tech accessories
* Corporate gifts
* Subscription boxes
* Chocolates and artisan food gifts

### **Outer Wrapping Papers**

For **custom rigid boxes designs**, outer wrapping papers are required that can create a catchy
appearance. The core material cannot be printed due to high porosity. That is why external wraps are
applied, which can be from the following:
* **Art paper:** This paper has a GSM range of 128 to 157. Art paper is used for crisp prints and is
  ideal for CMYK artwork with photographic images.
* **Kraft paper: **It gives an organic and tactile look to the boxes. Artisan brand perfect kraft
  paper.
* **Speciality metallic paper**: Some brands prefer paper material that gives mirror-like shoes and
  is used

        ## Approach
        
        HohuiFlex is a global leader in food and liquid packaging —working in partnership with our
        customers to deliver high quality, innovative solutions that achieve sustainable
        performance.
        
        [See more][4]
    * * [Sustainability][5]
      * Sustainability is one of our long-held core values. Learn about our commitment to
        sustainable packaging solutions, and how it can benefit both you and your customers
      * [Quality][6]
      * Quality is something you can always count on at HohuiFlex.
    * * [Partnership][7]
      * We are tenacious about finding solutions to your challenges, being here for your everyday
        needs and supporting your big-picture goals.
      * [Innovation][8]
      * Our proactive approach to innovation means we never stop thinking about how to do things
        better.We have sustained our reputation by honing in on–and developing–critical core
        competencies in film, pouch, and label for a wide range of market segments including:
        food,beverage and Non-food.
* [Solutions][9]
  * * * [Solutions]
        
        ## Solutions
        
        Whether you are in the business of food, beverages or other fluids, our best-in-class
        solutions can preserve and protect your product wherever it goes.
        
        [See more][10]
    * * [Beverage][11]
      * We have pioneered Bag-in-Box, pouch and label solutions for any beverage product, from
        alcoholic beverage and functional drink to soft drink,smoothie,fruit juice, water, tea and
        coffee.
      * [Food][12]
      * Our flexible packaging solutions preserve the integrity of your food products, whether it’s
        baby & toddler food,condiment & sauce,dairy,edible oil, fruit & vegetable,Pet food or
        nutraceutical.
      * [Non-food][13]
      * Our packaging for non-food products provides a range of solutions from safe packaging for
        industrial fluids to more sustainable alternatives for home and personal care products.
    * * [Label & Sleeve Solutions][14]
      * Maximize brand impact and consumer appeal with innovative, eco-friendly label and sleeve
        solutions.
* [Products][15]
  * * * [Products]
        
        ## Products
        
        Our solutions are designed for the full spectrum of food & liquid packaging needs—from
        bag-in-box, pouches and labels to fitments and dispensing solutions for rigid and flexible
        containers, fillers and more.
        
        [See more][16]
    * * [Stand Up Pouch][17]
      * Certified Stand-Up Pouches for Global Food & Beverage Brands, Export-ready. Fully
        customizable. Delivered fast.
      * [Flat Pouch][18]
      * Flat Pouches for Snacks, Powders, and Single-Serve SKUs, Lightweight. Certified. Built to
        protect — and impress.
    * * [Zipper Bag][19]
      * Resealable Zipper Bags for Food, Pet, and eCommerce Brands, Certified for global export.
        Engineered for freshness, function, and spee
      * [Spout Pouch][20]
      * Spouted Pouch Packaging for Liquid, Semi-Liquid & Pourable Products, Leakproof.
        Export-compliant. Built for hot fill, aseptic, and high-speed lines.
    * * [Label & Sleeve][21]
      * Transform your bottles with captivating labels - unleash the power of visual storytelling
        and elevate your brand's unforgettable identity.
      * [Flat Bottom Bags][22]
      * Flat Bottom Bags for Premium Food, Pet, and Coffee Brands, Rigid shelf presence. Large fill
        volume. Built for retail impact.
    * * [Bag-in-box][23]
      * Bag-in-Box Packaging for Bulk Liquids, Wine, and Foodservice SKUs, Space-saving. Leakproof.
        Certified for shelf-stable and cold-chain systems.
      * [Special Shape Bags][24]
      * Custom-Shaped Pouches for Brands That Refuse to Blend In, Stand out on the shelf, in the
        feed, and in the customer’s hand.
    * * [Retort Bags][25]
      * Retort Bags for High-Temperature Sterilization and Shelf-Stable Foods - Engineered for
        121°C. Built for global food brands.
      * [Microwave Sterilizer Bag][26]
      * Microwave Sterilizer Bags for Safe, Fast, On-the-Go Disinfection - No boiling. No chemicals.
        Just steam sterilization in 3 minutes.

# Your go-to packaging partner

We’re Mauser Packaging Solutions—we’re everywhere you are. Our packaging is in your garage, under
your sink, used to help your car run smoothly, helping keep your food safe, and even protecting your
doctors.

As your trusted rigid packaging manufacturer, we provide reliable products and services wherever you
do business. You can take advantage of our wide range of solutions that span the full packaging life
cycle, from design to recycling, that deliver high performance and durability while minimizing your
environmental impact.

Serving global customers for over 330 combined years, we understand the importance of getting to
know your business and providing responsive support. Your dedicated representative works closely
with you to get you what you need, when you need it.

[
Put us to work
][69]

## Source locally to do business globally

We’re dedicated to helping companies like yours operate more efficiently. And with more than 170
sites around the world, our global perspective matches our reach, allowing you to benefit from an
accessible, responsive and consistent supply chain.
[
Find a location near you
][70]

## Powering your sustainability strategy

Being an environmentally conscious consumer is more important than ever, and we’re here to
help—whether you’re looking to exceed stakeholder expectations, meet environmental regulations,
achieve green business targets, or just want an introduction to sustainable products and services.
Take a look at our sustainable solutions that can help you check those boxes, while also doing
something great for your business—and the planet.
[
See how we can support your sustainability strategy
][71]

## True sustainability

We’ve been focused on sustainability long before it was a popular priority. To us, sustainability is
more than a buzzword—it’s about doing more and using less for our customers, our employees, our
communities, and our world.

This means you have access to the industry’s most innovative packaging solutions that can help you
divert waste from landfills, reduce carbon emissions, preserve natural resources and comply with
environmental regulations. Our sustainable products and services can help you meet your short- and
long-term sustainability targets—while delivering high-performance, efficiency and reliability to
advance your business goals.

# Built on longevity

### We measure excellence in the length and strength of our customer relationships.

## Built on quality

#### High-quality market pulp

[MarketPulp_Pets]
[MarketPulp_Tissue]
[MarketPulp_paper]

Our state-of-the-art facility produces dry market pulp that becomes printing paper, tissue, pet
pads, insulated doors, filtration paper, Kraft paper, and more.

[ MARKET PULP ][28]

#### Premium paperboard

[Paperboard_juice]
[Paperboard_cups]
[Paperboard_milk]

Each year, we produce 300,000 metric tons of premium paperboard for cartons and cups, equivalent to
six billion liter-sized cartons of milk.

[ PAPERBOARD ][29]

## Built on sustainability

Customers care about where our chips come from and how our mill operates. We source raw materials
from responsibly managed forests and lean on our scientific staff to employ environmentally sound
practices in creating products.

[ ENVIRONMENTAL EFFORTS ][30]

## Built on people

We wouldn’t be Nippon Dynawave Packaging without the people who come to work with us each day and
the support of the community that we call home.

We’re committed to offering a dynamic work environment focused on safety, professional excellence,
delighting customers, and giving back to the community in any way we can.

## Obeikan

### Ready for tomorrow

It all started in 1982 with a single commercial print shop.

Today Obeikan Investment Group is a leader in packaging, education and health, We’re one of Saudi
Arabia’s 100 largest companies, with more than 3,000 employees and operations in 16 countries.

It’s a remarkable transformation from a single print shop. But thinking big has always been
Obeikan’s hallmark. And the transformation isn’t finished.

Today, we’re harnessing the power of technology to become constantly better—more productive, more
precise, more responsive—in everything we do. Now, digital transformation of our operations is the
common imperative across all of our business lines, elevating our products and service to
ever-higher levels.

The next chapter in the story of our success is centered on sharing digitally driven performance
excellence. Obeikan’s [**Digital Solutions**][154] streamline operations, improve productivity and
reduce costs, helping companies redefine their own success for a better tomorrow, right along with
us.

## Obeikan

### Ready for tomorrow

It all started in 1982 with a single commercial print shop.

Today Obeikan Investment Group is a leader in packaging, education and health, We’re one of Saudi
Arabia’s 100 largest companies, with more than 3,000 employees and operations in 16 countries.

It’s a remarkable transformation from a single print shop. But thinking big has always been
Obeikan’s hallmark. And the transformation isn’t finished.

Today, we’re harnessing the power of technology to become constantly better—more productive, more
precise, more responsive—in everything we do. Now, digital transformation of our operations is the
common imperative across all of our business lines, elevating our products and service to
ever-higher levels.

The next chapter in the story of our success is centered on sharing digitally driven performance
excellence. Obeikan’s [**Digital Solutions**][154] streamline operations, improve productivity and
reduce costs, helping companies redefine their own success for a better tomorrow, right along with
us.

industry-academia development.

### Green Manufacturing

70,000 m² workshop powered by rooftop solar, aligned with China’s dual-carbon goals.

## Special Processes

The range of Packaging Services we offer is almost unlimited. We take all the technical jargon and
manufacturing intricacies away to make it easy for you to understand.  Please review a small range
of the most popular branding methods chosen by our clients.

[Screen printing]

Screen Printing

Screen printing is an ancient printing technique particularly suited for flat or relatively flat
surfaces. The heart of this involves a fine mesh that is tightly stretched to create cheap printing

[Ribbon & Magnet closer]

Ribbon & Magnet 

Ribbons can be used to add a touch of class. Ribbons are perfect for pairing with magnet closures
for easy opening, or for a satisfyingly smooth drawer opening.

[Emboss rigid box sivakasi]

Embossing & Debossing

Embossing makes a design stand out from your boxes. It impresses an image or logo into a surface
using an engraved metal die. This creates a raised impression. In reverse, this can create a deboss.

[Spot Uv]

Spot UV

Spot UV can make areas of your design really stand out with high gloss or matte finish. A thick
varnish uses UV light to dry it quickly on top of the print.

[Rigid box thermography]

Thermography

Thermography is a finishing process which uses heat to produce raised characters using very dense
ink then dusted with a special powder and then heated  to weld it to the paper.

[Rigid boxes foil]

Foil Stamping

Foil stamping is the process of applying metallic or foil effects on your boxes. It uses a metal
die, like a stamp -onto which the design is chemically etched or crafted by hand from supplied
artwork.

Sun Chemical develops a wide range of [pigments and color materials][119] for architectural,
automotive and industrial coatings, cosmetics, plastics, printing inks, agricultural, and more.

## FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS

Can I order pouches with artwork on both the front and back?

Yes! We print on a flat web of film, which is folded into pouches later in the production process.

This means your artwork can cover the entire exterior surface of the pouch—including the gusset of
stand-up pouches.

Our [dielines][43] show the front, back, and gusset panels, and will help you make sure everything's
turned the right way after the pouch is folded.

Can I get a window in my pouch/film?

Yes! Windows require our **clear** film material.

We print a layer of opaque white ink first, then print the artwork on top—any areas without white
ink will be clear windows. Your print file *must* include this white ink layer in addition to the
regular artwork.

Our [Artwork Specifications][44] page include all the instructions and tools you'll need to create a
window in your design.

How should I create my artwork file?

The best way to create a print-ready art file is using Adobe Illustrator, and saving your work as a
high-resolution PDF file. For more information, please visit our [Artwork Specifications][45] page.

Can I combine multiple prints/files (SKUs) into one large order?

Yes, but **only for pouches with the same size and specifications** (material, finish, zipper, and
hang hole). You'll need to add separate items to your cart so you can upload each print file.

A range of Unilever products being used, as well as advertising lifestyle imagery. Text throughout
the video reads: “Unilever is home to some of the world’s most iconic brands. We’re staying 1, 2, 3
steps ahead. Transforming into a Marketing & Sales machine. With SASSY brands creating Desire at
Scale.”

## Detailed description

The video begins with a close-up of a woman with curly hair adorned with gold bows smiling directly
into the camera. Her hands move toward the lens, briefly obscuring the view as she frames her face.
She wears a soft, light-toned top and has bright blue nail polish, creating a vibrant contrast
against her skin. The text “Unilever is home” appears, suggesting the start of a message about the
company. The frame pans out to show the woman is wearing an off-shoulder dress and standing in a
grand, ornate room. Several other people are visible in the background in a masked ball setting in
an elaborate regency-style room.

The next frame shows a close-up of a revolving jar of Dove 10-in-1 Serum Mask Intensive Repair. The
jar is white with a gold-coloured lid, and the background is silvery grey. The overlaid text sitting
to the left of the product, which reads “to some of the world’s”, continues the message from the
previous screen.

The scene cuts to a refrigerator interior shot. A bottle of Hellmann’s Spicy Mayonnaise stands
upright in the centre, surrounded by fresh ingredients such as tomatoes and red peppers. Bold blue
text, which reads “most iconic”, overlays the image.

The frame then switches to a close-up of a hand lifting a white piece of fabric in iridescent pastel
lighting, with soft-focus people in the background. The person’s reflection is visible on the sheet.
The words “and beloved” are overlaid, and the Vaseline logo appears in the top corner.

Next, the camera transitions to a Persil Wonder Wash detergent bottle, angled dynamically with water
droplets against a clean, blue-toned background. The word “brands” appears on screen.

The video then cuts to an overhead shot of a jar of smooth white cream. A hand with red nail polish
uses a small spatula to scoop some of the cream. The words “We’re staying” appear over the product.

The next frame shows a close-up of smooth gel-like cream in soft peach tones, with the number “1”
overlaid. This is followed by an abstract close-up of liquid bubbles on a blue background, with the
number “2” overlaid. And then a close-up of fresh lime slices against a white background, with the
number “3” overlaid. Next, the video zooms in on hands holding a small gold box against a light
background, casting a soft shadow. The words “steps ahead” appear over the box.
